dblsc.title: Diccionario básico de la lengua de señas colombiana

cases.rule: Resolve declared endpoints for direction.
cases.context: A child walks from the school toward the park.
cases.rationale: CAMINAR can show the places between or toward which the child moves. The draft identifies the start and intended destination.

cases.rule: Resolve declared endpoints for demonstrative.
cases.context: The signer identifies the grandfather’s farm as the place where the family lives.
cases.rationale: The farm resolves ALLÁ. The source endpoint is an authoring anchor for the signer and has no trajectory meaning.

cases.rule: Resolve declared endpoints for agreement.
cases.context: Ana and Luis are established in the discourse. Ana helps Luis.
cases.rationale: AYUDAR can identify its subject and object. The draft records the helper and recipient and preserves the opaque agreement reference.

cases.rule: A direction endpoint must resolve to a declared locus.
cases.context: A child walks from the school toward the park.
cases.rationale: The park is the intended destination. The draft omits its referenced locus ID.

cases.rule: Agreement metadata is reserved for agreement relations.
cases.context: The signer identifies the grandfather’s farm as the place where the family lives.
cases.rationale: The expression identifies a place. Agreement metadata conflicts with this draft relation kind.

cases.rule: An agreement relation requires an agreement reference.
cases.context: Ana and Luis are established in the discourse. Ana helps Luis.
cases.rationale: The two participant references resolve. The draft omits the required agreement metadata.

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A child moves on two legs.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents a biped depicted in locomotion in the declared role.

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A spider moves on more than two limbs.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents a referent traveling on more than two limbs in the declared role.

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A walking person moves into the impact.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents the person moving into the impact in the declared role.

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A moving car runs into an obstacle.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents the moving vehicle in the declared role.

classifierAnnotations.sourceHandshapeNotation: active B with little-finger edge down

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A moving two-wheeled vehicle hits an obstacle.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents the moving two-wheeled vehicle in the declared role.

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A person hands a cylindrical drinking glass to someone else.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents the cylindrical object being given in the declared role.

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A person gives another person a needle.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents the tiny or thin item being given in the declared role.

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A person cuts material with scissors.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents scissors in the declared role.

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A person cuts with a knife depicted through its blade.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents the knife represented through its blade in the declared role.

classifierAnnotations.sourceHandshapeNotation: active B with the little-finger edge toward the material

cases.rule: Resolve the documented handshape, role and referent for this construction.
cases.context: A person cuts while the handshape depicts a knife grip.
cases.rationale: The handshape represents the knife being held in the declared role.

cases.rule: Reject an incompatible classifier handshapeClass.
cases.context: A child moves on two legs.
cases.rationale: The draft uses the multiple-limb handshape for the biped row.

cases.rule: Reject an incompatible classifier role.
cases.context: A person hands a cylindrical drinking glass to someone else.
cases.rationale: The handshape depicts the glass being given. The draft assigns the recipient role.

cases.rule: Reject an incompatible classifier referentClass.
cases.context: A moving two-wheeled vehicle hits an obstacle.
cases.rationale: The two-wheeled construction requires its declared referent class.

cases.rule: Reject an incompatible classifier id.
cases.context: A person cuts material with scissors.
cases.rationale: The instrument reference must resolve to the scissors declared for the draft.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: A person’s exceptional height is described.
cases.rationale: Characterizes person height through a sign specific endpoint.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: A person’s exceptionally short stature is described.
cases.rationale: Characterizes exceptionally small person height through a sign specific endpoint.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: A signer describes a book much larger than usual.
cases.rationale: Describes an exceptionally large book.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: A signer describes someone coming quickly.
cases.rationale: Coming quickly.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: A signer describes someone signing slowly.
cases.rationale: Signing slowly.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: A walk is described as continuing over time.
cases.rationale: Durative or continuative action.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: The AÑO construction incorporates a numeral for years.
cases.rationale: Introduces numeral information for the listed unit signs.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: ÁRBOL is repeated at distinct loci to describe several trees.
cases.rationale: Plural reference for the listed signs.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: Multiple people are seated. The hand draws several arcs.
cases.rationale: Pluralizes the seated participants.

cases.rule: Preserve the intended change of meaning and its qualitative operation in the draft trace.
cases.context: A signer refers to multiple children by continuing the movement horizontally.
cases.rationale: Plural reference to children.

cases.rule: Preserve the unmodified base meaning when no variant is declared.
cases.context: A signer describes someone coming. The manner is unspecified.
cases.rationale: The unmarked form supplies the comparison for rapid VENIR. The draft specifies no speed or added manner.

cases.rule: A sign-specific manner variant requires a source-listed gloss.
cases.context: A signer describes someone coming quickly.
cases.rationale: The dictionary describes faster VENIR and slower SEÑAR as distinct readings.

cases.rule: A standalone frequency variant has no documentary inventory entry.
cases.context: A walk is described as continuing over time.
cases.rationale: The source describes repetition qualitatively under aspect and supplies no event-rate parameter.

cases.rule: A SENTARSE arc count cannot be encoded as an exact participant count.
cases.context: Multiple people are seated. The hand draws several arcs.
cases.rationale: The source states that arc counts do not correspond one-to-one to seated people.

cases.rule: A size annotation cannot set an unreviewed numeric amplitude.
cases.context: A signer describes a book much larger than usual.
cases.rationale: The source describes a larger arc relative to the usual form and provides no absolute distance.
